$comment: PIP Context - The information object the PDP hands to the arbiter: the merged output of the registered information sources with the agreement's trustData spread over it. The subject is the consumer's public information captured in the negotiation trust token, so a constraint reads it as $.subject.role from the information data source.

verifiableCredential.$comment: Abbreviated. The trust verifier stores the whole verified credential under this key next to its credentialSubject under subject.
